playlist.playlist_description: On May 11, 1996, Dallas spent a Saturday morning at the Presbyterian Church of the Master in Mission Viejo, CA, teaching on the topic of forgiveness. You'll find encouragement, hope and freedom as Dallas shares definitions and practical steps to understand forgiveness, be able to receive and extend forgiveness, and ultimately live our daily life with God in a continual flow of blessing.
